activity: Mount Kenya (and Mount Kilimanjaro) trekking / climbing expeditions
sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/EXCURSIONS/MT. KENYA TOUR/FW_ MT KENYA & MT KILIMANJARO YEAR 2025 RATES.msg (and its .docx attachments)
$fileFormatNote: Source is an Outlook .msg email (forwarded internally at Sunworld, originally from Twining Safaris) with per-route .docx attachments, not a PDF. Opened programmatically via Python's extract_msg library since pdftotext/textutil cannot read .msg directly.
$anomaly: [Flag] This is a THIRD distinct Mount Kenya outfitter found in Sunworld's files, separate from African Ascents (see excursion-mount-kenya-african-ascents-2025-2027.json). Route names, durations, and pricing structure do not overlap cleanly with African Ascents' route set — e.g. Twining offers 'Sirimon In - Sirimon Out' and 'Kamweti In - Sirimon Out' variants not present in the African Ascents sheet. Confirm with Yasin/Sunworld which outfitter should be the default for a Mount Kenya quote, or present both as options per the project's 'flexible variable' convention.
$dateFlag: [Unverified] Email is dated 17 Jan 2025 and rates are explicitly labeled 'YEAR 2025 RATES'. This is the only Mount Kenya email/document found under this folder for either the 2026 or 2027 CONTRACT RATES tree — no 2026/2027 update from Twining Safaris was found. Treat as a stale/reference price until a current rate is confirmed.
currency: USD (Non-Resident); KES (Kenya Citizen and Resident/EAC tiers)
commissionNote: Twining Safaris' original quote states rates are 'commissionable to you at the rate of 10%.'

genericInclusionsAcrossRoutes: Accommodation whilst on safari (mountain huts/cabins, no tents needed on most routes)
All transfers as described in each route's itinerary
Mount Kenya park entry and conservation fees
Meals whilst mountaineering (and lunch at Nanyuki/exit point on some routes)
One porter per guest (guests carry only day packs)
